why-not-a-codemod: Measured, not assumed. A codemod over the whole suite tagged 443 tests and put 205 under @reserve:input because .press( and .type( appear in nearly every spec. Restricting it to unambiguous APIs still read process.execPath out of terminal-reattach's daemon setup and DataTransfer out of a test that actually drives the synthetic dropPaths() helper. The evidence for a test's CLAIM is not lexically distinguishable from the evidence for its SETUP, so every automated tag is a confident-looking false justification - the exact defect the tag exists to remove.
